title: InstallationStatusChangedPayload
description: Payload of the InstallationStatusChanged event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: platform, INV-REQ-1226, INV-Q-14289 A). The schema is owned by service-runtime; it is a copy of the tenancy payload schema of the same name, with installationRef bounded (INV-Q-14291 A). The event is written under the platform tenant with the platform entity. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

entityRef.description: The registered entity the installation belongs to, when the installation is entity-scoped.

installationRef.description: The installation reference, when the installation is not entity-scoped.

status.description: Whether the condition was raised or cleared.

cause.description: Free-text cause of the raise or clear.
